changes: Adapted event-driven cell and workbook parsing to shared openrsxl types without Range materialization
Separated generic numeric row streaming from eager workbook strings/styles and formula machinery
Resolved OPC root/workbook/sheet relationships and normalized internal part URIs
Kept namespace and end-tag validation enabled and added bounded input per XML event
Added checked coordinate arithmetic, sparse row ordering, projection before decoding, reusable rows and owned batches
Unsupported selected features fail explicitly; numeric decoding rejects invalid and non-finite values instead of falling back to strings
Added contextual errors and resource budgets; retained no global or interpreter-exit resource registry
M2 boolean branch uses shared CellValue::Boolean and validates zero/nonzero signed decimal integer literals instead of calamine literal-string comparison; no per-cell heap payload added
M2 scalar port preserves integer/float lexemes and arbitrary decimal integer literals; adds plain inline/value text and literal errors with shared compact owned models and heap-payload accounting
Normal formula and optional typed cache decoding integrated with shared Formula; data-only projection and owned expression/cache accounting; non-normal metadata remains explicitly unsupported
Date-format classifier validates explicit date styles before writing; bounded bracket depth and coherent duration interpretation
ports.tests: New in-memory OOXML fixtures in crates/openrsxl-xlsx/tests/streaming.rs; no upstream binary fixture copies

ports.license: MIT (selected from upstream MIT/Apache-2.0 dual license)
source_symbols: src/worksheet.rs: write_number_cell, write_inline_string_cell, write_boolean_cell, insert_cell/flush_to_row constant-memory flow
src/packager.rs: write_worksheet_file constant-memory sections and bounded io::copy
src/xmlwriter.rs: escape_xml_data, match_xml_char, escape_xml_escapes (inspection; unsupported text escape cases explicitly deferred)
src/styles.rs: write_fonts/write_font, write_fill, write_border, write_cell_xf, write_alignment, write_protection, write_num_fmt
changes: Adapted selected sequential spooling, scalar cell layouts and OPC packaging into the existing shared core rather than importing an upstream workbook model
Propagate typed I/O/validation/state errors instead of expect/unwrap or silently ignoring flushed rows
Encode one bounded reusable row before spooling; stream completed temporary worksheet files into ZIP; no whole-sheet XML buffer
Use owned temporary files with explicit finish/abort and all-resource cleanup; create next-sheet temporary resource before committing the state transition
Preserve exact integer literals and float lexical distinctions; text escapes XML and retains whitespace; reject unsupported OOXML escape-looking text instead of corrupting it
Finish uses caller-selected seekable output and may leave partial output on failure; no implicit workbook save on Drop
Adapt initial basic styles to a shared core model with deduplicated complete format IDs and bounded tables; advanced/named/theme styles remain M5
Adapt formula XML to typed optional caches, preserving missing/zero/false/text/error/date results without upstream fabricated default zero; shared/array/data-table metadata remains staged

Adapt Gregorian epoch/leapday conversion via foundational chrono with explicit fictitious-leapday epoch conversion errors, baseline millisecond calendar rounding and epoch-independent time/duration serials

M4 refactors the shared cell encoder to borrowed cloneable iterators for sparse model export and existing-cell replacement; editor/model logic is original implementation using foundational ZIP/XML APIs
ports.tests: New generated scalar round-trip and injected failure/cleanup tests in crates/openrsxl-xlsx/tests/writer.rs; Python public-API readback and benchmark inputs generated by benchmarks/writer_checkpoint.py
